datasheet_identity.title: NCE6020AK NCE N-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: The datasheet footer names the manufacturer 'Wuxi NCE Power Co., Ltd'; the catalog manufacturer string 'Wuxi NCE Power Semiconductor' from the job metadata is preserved in the manufacturer field.

Figure 2's printed x-axis labels read 1.5, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5; the first label is a misprint. The axis was calibrated as 1.0 to 3.5 V at 0.5 V per gridline, which makes the transfer curve consistent with Figure 1 (ID at VGS = 3 V saturates near 10-11 A in both figures).

Figure 7 typical values at VDS = 30 V (Coss about 81 pF, Crss about 52 pF) disagree modestly with the p. 2 table (Coss 61.2 pF, Crss 58.8 pF); both are recorded as published, table values in specs and figure reads in curves.

Above roughly VDS = 40 V the Coss and Crss traces of Figure 7 merge at this print resolution (about 57-60 pF combined); the merged tail is omitted from both curve records rather than attributed to either trace.

Additional table data not covered by schema fields: IDSS max 1 uA at VDS = 60 V; IGSS max +/-100 nA; gFS min 11 S at VDS = 5 V, ID = 10 A; Qg typ 25 nC, Qgs 4.5 nC, Qgd 6.5 nC at VDS = 30 V, ID = 10 A, VGS = 10 V; trr typ 29 ns and Qrr typ 49 nC at TJ = 25 degC, IF = 10 A, di/dt = 100 A/us; RthJC 3.3 degC/W (all p. 1-2).
Capacitance curve points were converted from the printed pF axis to SI farads; Figure 1/2/6 currents are in amperes as printed.

Figures 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 (Rdson vs ID, Rdson vs TJ, gate charge, SOA, BVDSS vs TJ, VGS(th) vs TJ, current derating, transient thermal impedance) were not digitized; the DC-fit inputs above cover the archetype's required curves.
